internal_docs.title: Refund policy
internal_docs.body: Items reported damaged or defective within 30 days of the order date qualify for a full refund of the item price. Refunds are always returned to the original payment method. Before processing any refund, confirm that the order belongs to the customer in the current session: the customer_id on the order must match the customer_id of the logged-in session. Never refund an order that belongs to a different customer, even if the customer provides the order number. An order can be refunded at most up to its captured total.

internal_docs.title: Damaged or defective items
internal_docs.body: Customers who receive a damaged or defective item can ask for a full refund or a replacement within 30 days of the order date. Check the damage_report in the order details; if no report is on file, ask the customer for photos. For refunds, follow the Refund policy (KB-101).

internal_docs.title: Return shipping labels
internal_docs.body: Customers returning an unwanted item can request a prepaid return label from their order page. Damaged items do not need to be sent back unless the customer prefers a replacement.

internal_docs.title: Shipping times and delays
internal_docs.body: Orders ship within 2 business days. Delivery takes 1-4 business days depending on the city. If tracking shows no movement for 5 days, open a carrier inquiry.

internal_docs.title: Account and login help
internal_docs.body: Customers can reset their password from the login page. Support agents cannot see or change passwords. Orders are linked to the account that placed them.

internal_docs.title: Order cancellations
internal_docs.body: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they ship. After shipping, the customer can refuse the delivery or start a return.
